tests.title: aucune fuite clé ; pas de token fictif

detail.textPreview:
Rendez-vous confirmé
Référence : REC008-MOCK-0001
Token de gestion : Non disponible

audit.rootCause: queryReplacement expression for $3 evaluates to undefined/null when appointment has neither token_gestion nor token; n8n omits the third bound parameter; PostgreSQL raises "there is no parameter $3". $1 and $2 were bound (session + reference present).

mockContract.appointmentObject:
const appointment = {
  id: '55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555',
  reference: 'REC008-MOCK-0001',
  statut: 'CONFIRME',
  email: 'camille.essai@example.test',
  telephone: '+33000000000',
  debut: '2026-11-03T09:00:00+01:00',
  fin: '2026-11-03T09:30:00+01:00',
  service: 'PASSEPORT',
  site: 'PARIS'
};
mockContract.tokenOptionalConclusion: Mock CreateAppointment returns reference without token/token_gestion. Workflow Préparer réponse création already treats token as optional (valueOrNull → "Non disponible"). Clôturer confirmation requires reference+appointmentId but not token. Therefore token is optional for finalization; must bind SQL NULL, never invent a token, never change mock silently.

Appeler CreateAppointment.tokenBehavior: n/a (request body has cleIdempotence, not token)

Classer réponse HTTP.tokenBehavior: forwards appointment as-is; does not require token for CONFIRMED (201 or replayed 200)

Clôturer confirmation.tokenBehavior: token not used; reference required for CONFIRMED

Finaliser état création.tokenAbsent: BEFORE: $3 omitted → PG error. AFTER: $3 bound as empty string → NULLIF → SQL NULL
Finaliser état création.referenceWithoutToken: BEFORE fail; AFTER reference kept, token NULL, session cleared
Finaliser état création.incompleteResponse: malformed body → UNCERTAIN upstream; Finaliser not reached on success path

Préparer réponse création.tokenBehavior: token = valueOrNull(token_gestion ?? token); displays "Non disponible" when absent; does not invent

fix.strategy: Always emit three queryReplacement string segments; coerce missing optional token to ""; SQL NULLIF($3::text, "") stores NULL. Same for reference safety with NULLIF($2::text, ""). No fake token. No CLAIM/POST/key changes.

recoveryPlan.observedInconsistency: attempt CONFIRMED with REC008-MOCK-0001; session still AWAIT_CREATE_CONFIRMATION
strategy: 1. Read-only: load session + latest attempt for session_id where status=CONFIRMED ordered by confirmed_at DESC.
2. If conversation_step is AWAIT_CREATE_CONFIRMATION (or ASK_*) and attempt CONFIRMED with non-empty appointment_reference: enter RECONCILE_CONFIRMED_SESSION.
3. Never CLAIM. Never POST CreateAppointment. Never regenerate idempotency key.
4. UPDATE ai_conversation_state: clear collection/pending/step; set reference = attempt.appointment_reference; set token = NULL (attempt has no token column; do not invent).
5. User-facing text: state that the appointment is already confirmed; include the real reference; token line "Non disponible" if none stored; do not claim a new creation.
6. Idempotent: second reconcile finds conversation_step already null + reference set → short already-confirmed ack, still no POST.
7. If attempt UNCERTAIN/SUBMITTING: do not use this finalize path.
